public_key: <base64 33B compressed P-256 point — the ARKG-derived key registered in the allowlist>
ikm: <64 hex chars = the 32 bytes of input keying material the key was derived from>

credential.key_handle: <base64 — handed back to the YubiKey so it can rebuild the private half>
credential.seed_public_key_cbor: <base64 CBOR COSE ARKG seed public key>
credential.attestation_object: <base64 CBOR, or null when made with attestation='none'>
